cwd.description: Absolute path of the agent's working directory. Must be non-empty.
cwd.title: Cwd

paths.description: Paths the action touches, for `file_read` and `file_write`. **Ignored for `shell`** — the service extracts paths itself from the command's syntax tree. Sending them for `shell` is harmless.
paths.title: Paths

domains.description: Domains the action contacts, for `network`. **Ignored for `shell`** — the service extracts domains itself from the command.
domains.title: Domains

mcp.description: Server, tool and arguments of an MCP call. Used for `tool: mcp_call`.

method.description: HTTP method of a `network` action, uppercase: GET, HEAD, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS. Optional — omitted means unknown, and unknown never earns a positive verdict. Ignored for tools other than `network`.
method.title: Method

Author.description:
Who produced a turn. A `human`-role turn authored by an `agent` is a
parent model's message to a subagent, not the user's intent.
Author.title: Author

tool.description: Name of the tool being called on that server.
tool.title: Tool

arguments.description: Arguments passed to the MCP tool.
arguments.title: Arguments

RuleSet.description:
The user's own deterministic policy, chosen at install time and edited by hand.

Patterns are matched against the canonical form of the normalized action
(argv joined by spaces, pipelines joined by ` | `) or against normalized
paths -- never against the raw command line. `allow` can never override
hard-deny or the server profile's denials.

version.description: Shape version. This service reads `1`; any other value is refused as `ask`.
version.title: Version

level.description: `low`, `medium`, `high`, or `custom` once edited. Recorded with the decision, not interpreted.
level.title: Level

allow.description: Runs without asking, unless hard-deny or the profile forbids it.
allow.title: Allow

RuleSet.title: RuleSet

Tool.description: Kind of action a harness can ask the gate about.
Tool.title: Tool

Turn.description: One turn of the dialogue that preceded the proposed action.

author.description: Who produced the turn. Only `human` marks the user's own words; a `human`-role turn with `author: agent` is text a parent model wrote for a subagent and is not treated as the user's intent.

content.description: The message text, the tool call as text, or the tool output. Visible turn text only: the agent's hidden reasoning (thinking blocks, scratchpads) must not be sent — the classifier is told it never sees it.
content.title: Content

call_id.description: Ties a `toolcall` to its `toolresult`. The same identifier the harness puts into its `Idempotency-Key`.
call_id.title: Call Id

Turn.title: Turn

TurnRole.description: What kind of dialogue turn this is.
TurnRole.title: TurnRole

description: One proposed agent action, plus the intent behind it.

session_id.description: Harness session identifier, at most 128 characters. Optional, but without it the service keeps no per-session counters and no allow cache, and the decision is stored with a null session.
session_id.title: Session Id

harness.description: Free-form name of the calling harness: `opencode`, `claude-code`, `codex`, `kilo`, `bench`, … 1-64 characters.
harness.title: Harness

raw.description: Raw payload as text. **Required and non-blank for `tool: shell`**, where it is the command line stage 1 parses; for the other tools it is the raw payload. At most 32768 **bytes** of UTF-8, not characters — Cyrillic costs 2 bytes per character. Over the limit the request is refused fail-closed as `ask` with HTTP 200.
raw.title: Raw

user_request.description: The user's last message, used as intent for the classifier. Not rejected when long: the server truncates it to 2048 characters **keeping the tail**.
user_request.title: User Request

profile_id.description: Server-side policy profile to apply; defaults to `default`. The harness never sees the profile contents.
profile_id.title: Profile Id

model.description: Name of a model configuration inside the profile. Overrides the profile's `models.default`.
model.title: Model

metadata.description: Arbitrary JSON, stored with the decision and echoed back by the decision feed. It never reaches the decision logic or the stage-2 prompt. At most 16384 bytes when serialized as UTF-8 JSON.
metadata.title: Metadata

protocol.description: Protocol version the client speaks. This service speaks `1`; any other value is refused fail-closed as `ask` with HTTP 200.
protocol.title: Protocol

history.description: The dialogue that preceded this action, oldest turn first; the last turn is the one immediately before the proposed action. At most 200 turns and 131072 bytes of UTF-8 text summed over `content`, `tool` and `call_id`, over which the request is refused fail-closed as `ask` with HTTP 200. Rendered into the stage-2 prompt after per-role truncation; never seen by stage 1. Empty for a v1 client, which changes nothing.
history.title: History

rules.description: The user's deterministic policy for stage 1 (see `RuleSet`). Optional; absent means the server profile alone decides. `deny` beats the server allowlist, `allow` never beats hard-deny or the profile.

call_id.description: Harness identifier of this tool invocation. Pairs the decision with the `POST /v1/inspect` of the same call in the feed.
call_id.title: Call Id

title: DecideRequest
